name: FastAPI-MCP
description: Expose any FastAPI application as an MCP server in a few lines — endpoints become tools automatically, preserving schemas, dependencies, and existing authentication.

skills.name: Endpoint Conversion
skills.description: Turns existing FastAPI routes into MCP tools automatically, carrying over request and response models as tool schemas.

skills.name: Auth Passthrough
skills.description: Reuses the FastAPI dependency system so existing authentication and authorization guards apply to MCP tool calls.

skills.name: Selective Exposure
skills.description: Filters which routes become tools by operation ID or tag, keeping internal endpoints out of the agent surface.
